pricing.description: NomNom is free to use. Some creator lists are paid — you pay the creator, not a platform subscription. Buy a Snapshot once or subscribe to a creator for monthly access to all their paid lists.
pricing.free_body: Create an account, set your tastes, and start discovering. No premium tier, no paywall on the platform itself.
pricing.free_item_browse: Browse free lists, follow creators and locals, build your own lists
pricing.free_item_features: Maps, search, vibe filters (Date Night, Friends, Cheap Eats, Corporate), and NomNom Roulette when you can’t decide
pricing.paid_body: Some creators paywall part of their lists. The first few spots on a paid list stay free; the rest unlock when you buy a Snapshot or subscribe to that creator. Payment goes to the creator (via Stripe); NomNom takes a small platform fee.
pricing.snapshot_body: A one-time payment for permanent access to one specific list, as it appears today. Perfect for an upcoming trip or a list you just want to keep.
pricing.snapshot_item_no_updates: No future updates if the creator changes the list
pricing.subscription_body: A monthly fee to one creator that unlocks all of their paid lists and notifies you whenever they add, remove, or update a spot.
pricing.subscription_item_all_lists: All paid lists from that creator
pricing.subscription_item_email: Email when they update a list
pricing.subscription_item_cancel: Cancel anytime in Settings → My subscriptions; access continues until the period ends

general-1.question: What is NomNom?
general-1.answer: NomNom is where food creators in Lisbon and Porto publish their restaurant recommendations as curated lists. Instead of scrolling through TikTok saves or lost WhatsApp messages, you get one link with every place a creator recommends — organised, searchable, and shareable.

general-2.question: How does it work?
general-2.answer: Creators build lists of restaurants they’ve visited and trust. To see a paid list, you buy a Snapshot (one-time) or subscribe to their lists (monthly).

general-3.question: How is NomNom different from Google Maps or TripAdvisor?
general-3.answer: NomNom shows places chosen by specific people whose taste you trust — a food creator whose Lisbon recommendations you follow, a local whose Porto picks you’ve relied on. Every restaurant is there because a real person put it there, with their name on it, rather than an anonymous star average.

general-4.question: Is there a mobile app?
general-4.answer: The web app works on any phone — no download needed. Open a public list link and it works instantly. A native iOS and Android app is coming.

general-5.question: What data do you collect about me?
general-5.answer: We collect what we need to run the app — account details, taste preferences, and saved places. If you purchase a list, your email is collected at checkout for receipts. You can delete your account and all data from Settings at any time.

payment-1.question: Is it free to browse lists?
payment-1.answer: Free lists are open to anyone. For paid lists, you can buy a Snapshot (one-time payment, permanent access to that specific list) or subscribe to the creator’s lists (monthly fee, unlocks all their paid lists and notifies you when they add new places).

payment-2.question: What’s the difference between a Snapshot and a Subscription?
payment-2.answer: A Snapshot is a one-time purchase that gives you permanent access to a specific list as it appears today — no future updates, no other lists. A Subscription is a monthly fee that unlocks all paid lists by that creator and sends you an email when they add, remove, or update a restaurant. If you follow one creator regularly, a Subscription is better value. If you just need a list for an upcoming trip, a Snapshot is perfect.

getting_started-2.question: Can I create my own list?
getting_started-2.answer: Yes. Create a list, add restaurants, and choose who can find it. Public lists are free for everyone. For paid access, set audience to “Subscribers”, publish the list, and set up payouts in Billing & payouts — subscribers pay your monthly price to see the full list and get notified when you add new places.

getting_started-3.question: How do I cancel a subscription?
getting_started-3.answer: Go to Settings → My subscriptions at any time. Cancel with one tap — you keep access until the end of your current billing period, then no further charges. Snapshots are permanent one-time purchases and are not refundable.
